verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own materials claim outputs print 'lineage back to the source line' and say users can 'open that Model, check every number' and adjust assumptions. Formulas are first-class: users can write them, and Excel exports keep them. Together this covers tracing a report number through formulas to source lines. missing for 10: a detailed doc on how the lineage/drill-down view works from a report number through formula chains to ledger lines (the lineage claim is a context-less fragment), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
